headline: Marban Hollow Shifts Colonial; Warden Gain at Kuura Strand
war_summary: Since our last edition the balance in Marban Hollow has swung sharply: Colonials now hold six of eight strategic posts against a lone Warden banner, one more lying in ruin, with Checkpoint Bua logging better than twenty flag actions in the day. Weathered Expanse remains the war's bloodiest ground — fifty-two flag events in twenty-four hours and fresh exchanges minutes before this filing — where Wardens now count three posts and Crow's Nest drew the fiercest work. Kuura Strand is no longer wholly Colonial: Wardens have retaken one shore post, Faden Point alone accounting for a dozen events. Nevish Line stands at four Warden, two Colonial and two demolished strongpoints after heavy fighting at Princefal and Tomb Father. Linn Mercy has stirred anew about Lathair and Outwich Ranch, and at Godcrofts the post at Argosa dropped to no-man's-land within the half-hour. Pari Peak and Olavis Wake, busy through yesterday evening, have since gone quiet. Callahans Passage, without a single flag event, still counted some seventy-three hundred casualties. This is the war's 685th day; thirty-four victory towns are required, and no victor is declared.
